title: Order Item Input Value
description: A record of one answer the buyer supplied for an order line, as it stood at checkout.

id.description: The `id` of the input that was answered. A historical reference that need not still resolve in the catalog.

label.description: The input's buyer-facing name at the time of purchase.

type.description: The input's type at the time of purchase. Well-known values: `text`, `choice`, `boolean`, `date`. Platforms MUST tolerate unknown values.

value_label.description: For a `choice` input, the buyer-facing name of the selected option at the time of purchase.
